'''Manganese brass''' was an alloy metal created using [[Manganese/Legends|manganese]] and [[Brass/Legends|brass]]. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] made [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Luminara's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a manganese brass [[radiator]] [[Radiator casing|casing]], a treatment which prevented corrosion.
